observations: Manual sewing machine head mounted on a wooden table.
The machine body is black with gold-colored decorative decals.
A spool of white thread is placed on the spool pin.
The wooden table surface shows significant wear, scratches, and peeling of the top layer.
The handwheel and belt area are visible on the right side.
A watermark from a classifieds site (Jiji) is present on the image.

claims.evidence: A still photo cannot demonstrate mechanical timing or the ability to form stitches.

risks.risk: Internal mechanical parts may be seized, rusted, or have timing issues.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine sewing a piece of fabric.

risks.risk: Essential components like the bobbin case, shuttle, or needle plate may be missing or damaged.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the underside of the head and the open bobbin compartment.

risks.risk: The treadle stand, legs, or foot pedal may be broken or missing.
risks.proof: A full-length photo showing the entire stand and the foot pedal mechanism.

proof_requests: Video of the machine sewing a sample of fabric.
Photo of the bobbin area and the underside of the machine head.
Full-length photo showing the legs and treadle pedal of the stand.
response.reason: The item is clearly a manual sewing machine. While the brand is not legible and functionality is unproven, it can be priced at its worst-case value as a non-functional unit for parts or restoration.
